text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu suffered a defeat. However, 
her overwhelming presence on the track 
only raised the crowd's expectations for 
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Intoxicated by the heat of the race, 
Mejiro Ramonu craves an even greater high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the first leg of the 
Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho. The two of them 
prepare for the coming battle.
